title: Puffco Pivot Portable Dab Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
The Puffco Pivot

The full Puffco experience in your pocket

The same size as a pen, this discreet, mobile vaporizer features a quick-release 3D Chamber that delivers premium flavor and real-time temperature control. With a light bar that serves as a visual dab timer, haptic feedback, a single-button interface, and four dialed heat presets, the Pivot is a true dab you can take anywhere. Low profile. High performance.

Product Features:
– 3D Chamber
– Up to 15 dabs per charge
– 4 heat settings
– Real-time temperature control
– USB-C connection

What’s Included:
1 x Pivot Base
1 x Pivot Chamber
1 x Pivot Mouthpiece
1 x Cotton Swabs
1 x Loading Tool
1 x USB-C Cable

Warranty
For any device or troubleshooting issues, please email support@puffco.com
